verdict.rationale: The evidence shows only developer building blocks: built-in latency and usage metrics enabled through configuration, transcript collection, audio recording, and the Whisker pipeline debugger. Nothing documents a ready-made analytics dashboard showing call success rates, durations, outcomes or sentiment, in either the framework or Pipecat Cloud. A founder would still have to build that themselves.

support.subject: As a founder, I can see call analytics — success rates, durations, outcomes, sentiment — in dashboards without building my own
